description: Check email syntax, domain routing and disposable-address signals in one batch. 0.0006 USDC per address, minimum 0.001 USDC per request; up to 100 addresses.

emails.description: Between 1 and 100 addresses. Billed at 0.0006 USDC per address with a 0.001 USDC minimum charge.

smtp_check.description: Ask for an optional SMTP probe. Off by default, heavily throttled, one attempt per target and never retried. Without it the verdict of a routable address stays "unknown".

name: email_batch
